Definition: properly, a feller, i.e. an axe
BiblicalUsage: The psalm remembers the enemy breaking down the carved work of the sanctuary with axes, smashing what was made beautiful for God's house.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that what men build for God can be broken by men, but the God it was built for is never broken.
